patch_description:
The current program uses a single current-to-best DE donor rule (`population + attraction*(best-population) + factor*(a-b)`) with population 384, 720 generations, two 20% restarts, and 260 batch-polish rounds. This can converge prematurely because every member is increasingly pulled toward the same phase-locked basin.

The revised implementation retains the efficient six-parameter 3-ring construction and guaranteed unit-area triangular hull, but replaces the single donor strategy with a deterministic progress-scheduled mutation portfolio: broad `rand/1` donors dominate early exploration, current-to-elite donors become more frequent during exploitation, and elite-difference donors supply late basin refinement. Selection uses a lower-tail merit early in the run, improving several near-active triangle constraints rather than only the single current minimum. Final polishing is active-constraint weighted, preferentially perturbing rings participating in small triangles.
